d:
Ed Yardeni, President and Chief Investment Strategist at Yardeni Research, described the market’s sharp intraday reversal as another attempt to find a bottom, following recent steep losses and Monday’s dramatic rebound. He pointed to support around 69,077,000 as transcribed, and said dip buyers were stepping in at these levels. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close."
